final: WITH per AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 AND rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM per WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio, p.avg_ratio - o.overall_mean AS above_overall_mean FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_ratio > o.overall_mean ORDER BY p.rating
